title: [DEV 3.2.0-dev-j cd9f5e4] Problem opening preferences
symptom: When opening any option that accesses anything related to preferences, the application crashes and closes. The problem recurs days later or right after an EOPatch2 patch activation, and can be temporarily relieved by switching the pump plugin or deactivating the patch.
cause: The EOPatch2 plugin appears to be responsible; after an EOPatch2 patch activation the preferences become inaccessible, while selecting another pump (e.g. Virtual Pump) or deactivating the patch restores access.
fix: MilosKozak stated 'temporary fixed by' commit a5774b6e2eb398311c80e9e00c01bede82978633. Users also found switching the pump plugin away from EOPatch2 (e.g. to Virtual Pump) or deactivating the patch temporarily allowed preferences to open.
